proposed_required_run: coupled portfolio/cohort replay with separately labeled return-path overlay diagnostic
calendar_scope: Ten project years to match existing 120-month business schedules. Full 2014-2026 source backtest is regenerated unchanged; no extrapolation, filling or hidden schedule extension.

proposed_accounting.owner_units: Initial committed USD7m at unit NAV100; investment entry costs lower NAV once. Owner units fixed, no owner redemptions.
proposed_accounting.event_order: Mark prices/accrue financing, execute prior investment signal, charge separately proposed fund fee, redeem/subscribe, execute net-flow portfolio adjustment, form next investment signal.
proposed_accounting.fund_fee: Existing annual 5bp /12 on previous event closing/opening period assets, separately attributed to owner/external units. Zero-added-fee baseline control also required.
proposed_accounting.new_flow_trades: Net simultaneous subscriptions/redemptions; proportional current sleeve mixture. Preserve pre-flow effective leverage after solving baseline trade costs; do not reset to target weights or 1.25x merely because money arrives.
proposed_accounting.cost_allocation: Units redeemed/issued at post-fund-fee, pre-flow-trade-cost NAV. Flow transaction costs borne by remaining fund units; no exit levy, swing pricing, market impact or per-client brokerage invented.
proposed_accounting.signals: Existing investment trades execute on next common NAV. Flow fees/trades feed subsequent signals. No-flow/zero-added-fee history must match original every observation.
proposed_accounting.business_costs: Manager costs paid outside fund. External fee receipts remain distinct from internal owner-group transfers; setup paid once in model month1.
proposed_accounting.stress: Fixed schedules only; no future negative-year knowledge used to cut sales or increase redemptions.
proposed_accounting.annualisation: Actual dated periods, 365.2425 calendar-year convention. Investor money-weighted returns require dated cash flows, not equal-month IRR relabeled as XIRR.

execution_status: Neither proposed coupled replay nor cash-flow overlay is implemented by the calendar audit. Proposed assumptions remain visible and versioned before accounting extension.
